supersedes.relationship: The Phase 8-A contract is NOT edited and remains in force in its own repository. This is a separate, versioned, Paper-Trader-native contract. No Phase 8-A rule is silently overridden: every retired rule is listed in retired_restrictions with the authority that retired it.

authority.authorised_by: the repository owner, by explicit written directive
authority.note: An agent may never widen this contract on its own authority. A scope change is a new contract version authorised the same way.

retired_restrictions.phase_8a_rule: universe restricted to S&P 500 Current & Past
retired_restrictions.v2_rule: multi-asset: any scope in the alpha_agent.r59 asset-class vocabulary with an owned point-in-time panel
long/short research is allowed where an execution representation exists for both legs; a leg that cannot be expressed is reported, never silently dropped
multiple natural horizons including H1-H5 sessions; horizon variants of one idea count as ONE search family

retired_restrictions.phase_8a_rule: five price families only (momentum, reversal, trend_breakout, volatility_liquidity, breadth_relative_strength)
retired_restrictions.v2_rule: trend, reversal, carry, breadth, volatility, liquidity, factor, valuation, quality, profitability, cash-flow, regime, cross-asset and mathematical/statistical families
fundamentals allowed if and only if point-in-time safe (filing-availability timestamped, no restated values, delisted names retained)
regime HYPOTHESES are researchable; a regime rule is pre-registered and gated like any other signal and never switches an operational book
futures and long/short books may be researched at their natural notional with cost charged on traded notional; operational leverage remains out of scope

retired_restrictions.phase_8a_rule: ML fitting beyond deterministic score rules forbidden; optimized ensemble weights forbidden
retired_restrictions.v2_rule: meta-model research is allowed over validated survivors only, fitted on discovery data only, with every fitted degree of freedom charged to the search burden
Paper Trader integration is the purpose: durable state is owned by alpha_agent.r59 and the canonical forward-evidence owners
commit and push of research code, contracts and agent definitions are allowed after validation passes; operational stores are never committed

retired_restrictions.phase_8a_rule: Bash tool granted to every agent
retired_restrictions.v2_rule: Windows PowerShell only; no agent definition grants Bash or WSL

retired_restrictions.phase_8a_rule: signal-publishing-agent is preview-only forever, no Paper Trader integration
retired_restrictions.v2_rule: signal-publishing-agent may publish a research candidate artifact and raise a GOVERNED prospective registration request; see signal_publishing_boundary

retired_restrictions.phase_8a_rule: max 20 experiments per cycle, EXP00-EXP99 identifiers
retired_restrictions.v2_rule: budget set per campaign by the director and charged against the counted estate burden; identifiers are content-derived hypothesis ids owned by the research memory

retired_restrictions.phase_8a_rule: Norgate local data is the only provider
retired_restrictions.v2_rule: any OWNED point-in-time dataset already on disk; a new paid dataset still requires docs/INFORMATION_PURCHASE_GATE.md

preserved_safety_principles.rule: no backfill masquerading as forward evidence
failure recording: every experiment is recorded, including the ones that fail
every experiment has an experiment id before it is evaluated
realistic transaction costs, charged on traded notional
no rounding weak evidence into a pass
no hidden deletion of failed experiments
no hallucinated data, field, result or API behaviour; unknown stays unknown

explicit_allowances: long/short research where execution representation exists
PIT-safe valuation / quality / profitability / cash-flow signals
trend / reversal / carry / breadth / volatility / liquidity / factor work
integration with Paper Trader alpha_agent / R59
commit / push of research code and agent definitions
no_duplicate_engine_rule: The agents orchestrate. They add no second registry, gate, queue, forward clock, P&L owner or tournament. A capability that already has a canonical owner is reached THROUGH that owner.

may: create a governed prospective registration request
start research shadow P&L (by raising that request; the P&L itself is measured by the forward-evidence owner)

attach a qualified candidate to canonical forward accrual (the freeze through alpha_agent.r59.handlers.freeze_qualified; the forward clock through the ONE operator door scripts/adopt_prospective_freeze.py, run by a human)
signal_publishing_boundary.adoption_rule: The agents never start a forward clock. scripts/alpha_agents_v2.py composes no adoption owner, takes no confirmation token and has no execute mode; it is deliberately not a second operator adoption entrypoint.
may_not: make a sleeve capital eligible by itself

retained_authorities.orders_and_fills: nobody in this system; Create Orders is not implemented
retained_authorities.champion_promotion: a human; automatic model promotion is disabled
retained_authorities.capital_eligibility: api.capital_eligibility_gate, from matured forward evidence plus a pre-declared conditional approval

forward_evidence_rules: A historical result is never forward evidence; ResearchMemory.record_result refuses to mint it.
The forward clock of a registration starts at today's prospective boundary, never at an earlier inception.
A session that completed before registration can never become a prediction.
A registration whose frozen-decision producer does not exist accrues nothing and is reported FORWARD_PRODUCER_REQUIRED; a book is never guessed.
